tasks.subject: Fix delayed pin/sidebar updates (3.3s snapshot rebuild)
tasks.description: POST /pin and GET /bootstrap each take ~3.3s locally. Root cause: IndexSnapshot::build (crates/pecan/src/server/snapshot.rs) creates `ScanCache::new()` fresh on every build, so the mtime-keyed incremental cache is never reused and all ~3.8k session files (3.5GB tree) are re-scanned. Fix: hold a persistent ScanCache on the App state (e.g. Arc<Mutex<ScanCache>>) and pass it into IndexSnapshot::build so steady-state refreshes only parse changed files.

tasks.subject: Make thread/subagent navigation instantaneous
tasks.description: Moving between threads, subagents, and back to parents is slow. Every navigation calls GET /api/session/{id} which runs thread::parse_thread (crates/pecan-core/src/thread.rs) — a full read + JSON-parse of the entire session JSONL on every request, no caching. Also each route change triggers snapshot rebuilds (see pin-delay task). Fix: cache parsed ThreadViews keyed by (path, mtime, size), invalidate on change; reuse the persistent ScanCache.

tasks.subject: Fix mobile horizontal overflow on expand/message bubbles
tasks.description: On mobile (iPhone, ~390px viewport), expanded content and user message bubbles overflow horizontally and are clipped off the LEFT edge — text starts off-screen (screenshots: pecan.png, CleanShot 2026-08-24 01.21.35/01.23.17). Suspects: thread.tsx message/tool-call containers missing min-w-0 on flex parents, chat-markdown pre/code not constrained, or user bubble (max-w-[85%] rounded bubble in thread.tsx:245) inside a flex row that lets content force width. Ensure overflow-x containment (min-w-0, break-words, overflow-x-auto on pre) so nothing escapes the viewport on either side.

tasks.subject: Support image paste/upload in mobile composer
tasks.description: Add the ability to attach images to a message in the composer (web/src/components/composer.tsx): clipboard paste on desktop and photo upload / camera picker on phone (input type=file accept=image/* with capture support). Needs: client attachment preview + upload endpoint server-side, and message payload carrying image blocks to the pi session.

tasks.subject: Fix pin/bootstrap 3.3s delay: reuse ScanCache across snapshot rebuilds
tasks.description: IndexSnapshot::build creates ScanCache::new() each refresh, re-walking 3,849 files / 3.5GB every pin, unpin, refresh. Hold a shared ScanCache on App state and pass into build. Also consider making pin/unpin not block on the full rebuild. Measure before/after with curl timing.

tasks.subject: Speed up thread navigation (parse_thread on every open)
tasks.description: GET /api/session/{id} runs thread::parse_thread on the full JSONL every navigation with no caching. Add mtime-keyed caching of parsed thread views (bounded LRU or per-session cache invalidated by mtime/size). Measure navigation latency before/after on a large session.

tasks.subject: Fix new-session error: worker reported no session id within startup window
tasks.description: POST new session polls worker.get_state() 20x250ms for data.sessionId and fails. Debug why the id never materializes (check worker spawn, RPC handshake, pi CLI args). Reproduce locally, fix, add test for success path.
